package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_error_handling_cost_errors_wrap_in_tight_loop: Layer: Error handling cost. Flag repeated error wrapping inside loops where one aggregated context would be cheaper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func ValidateIDs(ids []int) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		if err := checkID(id); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("item %d: %w", id, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func checkID(id int) error {
	if id < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("negative id")
	}
	return nil
}
